secret_scan.method: Scanned only .log files below the tracking and restricted .tmp directories for bearer/JWT/token/ticket/password/secret/authorization/private-key shaped values. Values are never emitted.

findings.finding: The canonical 52-component matrix remains not_run/result=null and all 22 canonical E2E targets remain not_run/result=null. Owner PASS values were not promoted.

Backend/toolbox owner snapshots still report the 246-pass Toolbox library run, while the later root report records the current all-features run as 267; the 246 logs remain historical evidence only. Current same-log pass counts were checked and have no direct mismatch.

Current owner reports contain 71 explicit source:line references. Six current issue records have only source/static references and no operational log/fixture evidence; none of the four owner PASS records is source-only. Source lines cannot substitute for runtime execution.
Owner reports were generated from different source revisions and the current worktrees are dirty; report evidence is snapshot-scoped and is not proof of one integrated final commit.

The schema47 Go race/full Backend runs retain TestStrictRosterRustRelayClients as an explicit SKIP because the driver is unavailable. Root has an independent Go/Rust relay PASS for BP-013; that result is valid in its own scope and does not turn the Backend skipped test into a pass.

The earlier implementation-evidence-index records BP-007 and BP-011 as empty issue evidence and says filesystem verification was not performed. The current root report now contains evidence paths for both, and this audit resolved all current root evidence paths; the index entry is stale.

create_acceptance_ledger.py hard-codes BP-002/BP-003/BP-013/BP-022 into whole_component_pass and emits PASS without checking each owner review status or an evidence predicate. The current canonical acceptance matrix is still not_run/result=null. A manual review of the original expected wording and the existing executed evidence finds component-scope coverage for all four, but this is not a whole 52-item matrix, native gameplay E2E, or release PASS. AC-022 is especially a mixed-owner case: native has PASS while root and Toolbox retain PARTIAL, so the hard-coded rule must not hide that provenance.

findings.finding: Backend report was checked issue by issue. It has 12 implementation=implemented and 3 implementation=partial, but all 15 acceptance values are PARTIAL or BLOCKED (13 PARTIAL, 2 BLOCKED; no PASS). Each known integration, native, fault-injection, production, or release gap is stated in the issue note. Therefore no Backend acceptance is overclaimed. The word implemented is defensible as code-level implementation; BP-046/BP-047 must remain BLOCKED and must not be read as end-to-end readiness.

findings.finding: F1 pre-spawn cleanup is closed in the current frozen Toolbox worktree: room/route/path/begin_launch failures are converted to the sealed NativeProcessNotStarted marker, bound to exact attempt/session/roster/route with empty world, and sent only to the not-started Backend cleanup endpoint. F2 post-spawn failures are typed AuthorityLaunchFailure; a missing duplicated handle stays Option=None/PID metadata and is quarantined, never converted to native_process_not_started or owned_process_exited. This is safe fail-closed behavior, but final native teardown and supervisor marker integration remain outside the executed acceptance.

recommendations_for_root: Keep canonical breakpoint and acceptance-tests states unchanged until acceptance owners record results; do not treat component candidates as release-wide PASS.

Preserve the three Backend race skips, including Rust relay, even though root BP-013 has independent cross-language relay evidence.
